title: Why am I being charged a fee on my True Blue Account?
summary: Explains why customers are charged fees on a True Blue Account, listing Monthly Maintenance ($75.00, waived if average/qualifying balance meets $50,000), Domestic Wire Transfer ($5.00 per outbound domestic wire), Out-of-Network ATM ($1.00 per transaction), and Foreign ATM Withdrawal (2% of withdrawal, minimum $3.00), plus how to identify each fee from statements and avoid them.
faqs: What fee types can appear on my True Blue Account and when do they apply?
How can I tell if my $75.00 charge is the Monthly Maintenance Fee and how can I waive it?
Why was I charged $5.00 for a domestic wire transfer?
Why did I get a $1.00 Out-of-Network ATM fee, and how do I avoid it?
How is the Foreign ATM Withdrawal fee calculated (including the $3.00 minimum)?
How do I confirm which fee was charged using my statement or transaction history?
keywords: waived when $50,000 balance requirement is met
